item.tib: g.yang sgrub 'dod rgu gter phreng gi gter srung srid rgyal drel dmar
item.coloph: zhes pas g.yang sgrub 'dod rgu gter phreng gi srung ma srid rgyal dre'u dmar po'i bcol bskul 'di ni/ zab gter bdag nyid nyag gter mkha' 'gro'i ming 'dzin bde chen dbang mos gter nas spyan drangs nas slar gong sprul rnam gnyis dbal sprul g.yung drung mtshams pa g.yung drung rnam dag sogs kyis bskul ngor shog ser las d+ha k+ki'i ming 'dzin bde chen dbang mos phab pa'o//
